description: This file defines a GLES20TriangleRenderer class implementing OpenGL ES 2.0 rendering for a rotating textured triangle in an Android application.

classes.name: GLES20TriangleRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for drawing a rotating textured triangle using OpenGL ES 2.0 in Android.

methods.name: GLES20TriangleRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with context and setting up vertex buffer.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Renders a frame, clearing buffers, setting up textures, applying transformations, and drawing the triangle.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts the viewport and projection matrix when the surface size changes.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes shaders, program, textures, and view matrices when the surface is created.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of given type from source code.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Links vertex and fragment shaders into an OpenGL program.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors and throws exception if any.
